@startuml POST /v1/example
title POST /v1/example

' =========================

!define COLOR_RED_BOLDER        #AE2E24
!define COLOR_ORANGE_BOLDER     #A54900
!define COLOR_YELLOW_BOLDER     #946F01

' =========================
' Row 2 – Default
' =========================
!define COLOR_RED               #CA372C
!define COLOR_ORANGE            #C35100

!define COLOR_GREEN             #21835A
!define COLOR_TEAL              #227D9B

' =========================
' Row 3 – Subtle
' =========================
!define COLOR_RED_SUBTLE        #F87169
!define COLOR_ORANGE_SUBTLE     #FEA263
!define COLOR_YELLOW_SUBTLE     #F4CD47
!define COLOR_LIME_SUBTLE       #699A23
!define COLOR_GREEN_SUBTLE      #23A06B
!define COLOR_TEAL_SUBTLE       #2998BD
!define COLOR_BLUE_SUBTLE       #1E7AFD

' =========================

' =========================
!define COLOR_RED_SUBTLEST      #FFD5D2
!define COLOR_ORANGE_SUBTLEST   #FEDEC7
!define COLOR_YELLOW_SUBTLEST   #F8E5A0
!define COLOR_LIME_SUBTLEST     #D3F1A6
!define COLOR_GREEN_SUBTLEST    #B9F4DC
!define COLOR_TEAL_SUBTLEST     #C5ECFB
!define COLOR_BLUE_SUBTLEST     #CCE0FF
!define COLOR_PINK_SUBTLEST     #FDD0EC
!define COLOR_PURPLE_SUBTLEST   #DFD8FD

'''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

' =========================
' Diagram participants
' =========================
actor Requestor as requestor #DeepSkyBlue

box "Microservice" #PowderBlue
  control "service" as service #DeepSkyBlue
  database "config" as config #DeepSkyBlue
endbox

' =========================
' Formatting options
' =========================
hide footbox
'autonumber

skinparam defaultFontName Comic Sans MS
skinparam sequence {
  ParticipantFontSize 15
  ActorFontSize 15
  ArrowFontName Comic Sans MS
  ParticipantFontName Comic Sans MS
}

' =========================
' Microservice logic
' =========================
requestor -> service : request
activate service

group Get Config
  service -> config++ : findConfigByParameterKeysAndIsDeletedFalse()
  note right of service
    Parameter keys:
    * application.feature.enabled
    * application.timeout.seconds

    SELECT parameter_key, parameter_value
    FROM config
    WHERE parameter_key IN (:parameterKeys)
    AND is_deleted = 0;
  end note
  config --> service-- : configResponse

  break IF any config key is missing
    service --> requestor : HTTP 500, code: 80000
  end break
end group

service --> requestor : HTTP 200
deactivate service
@enduml

nested sequence with notes and else
source:
@startuml
group Request
alt valid
A -> B: {payload}
note right of B
  SELECT id
    FROM config
end note
else invalid
loop Retry
B --> A: Failed
end
end
end
